LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaShortWhip.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid short whip
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaShortWhip.description: A multi-lash short whip for suppression. Polymer braids use an improved poison treatment and internal fluid channels to deliver aphrodisiac nanofluid through shallow cuts.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaNeedleRepeater.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid repeating needle gun
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaNeedleRepeater.description: A pneumatic needle gun firing three-round bursts of fluid-bearing needles. Effective for repeated delivery at close to medium range, but inaccurate at long range.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaNeedleRifle.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid precision needle gun
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaNeedleRifle.description: A single-shot pneumatic needle gun for accurate long-range delivery. Its specialized needles carry a larger dose of aphrodisiac nanofluid, at the cost of slower aiming and firing.
